name: Beefeater Marlowe

intro.text: Good morning! I am a Yeoman Warder of the Tower. I should say, this is a friendly bout. We have a long tradition of those. And of tea.

win: Splendid. Very good form. Mind the cobbles on your way out.
after: In our tradition a Beefeater lives inside the Tower, and the gates are locked at ten every night for the Ceremony of the Keys. It's a very strict curfew.
